items.title: What is design engineering?
items.description: Where design intuition meets code execution — enabling you to see UI problems and build solutions from the ground up.

items.title: What is the craft of UI?
items.description: A course about building things well — mastering the web platform so you're not limited by tools or libraries.

items.title: Why focus on the web platform?
items.description: Because when you work with the web — not fight it — you unlock performance, accessibility, and durability that last.

items.title: Why does craft matter?
items.description: Because it's more than making something work — it's making something feel right: inclusive, resilient, and scalable.

items.title: Who is this for?
items.description: Designers who code, developers who design — anyone ready to stop chasing snippets and become the person who can build anything.

blocks.title: How it works.
blocks.description: Clicking a step slides the panel column — three panels stacked in one grid cell, each offset by index * 100% along the Y axis.

steps.title: Issue credentials from your portal
steps.description: Control the look and feel of your credential issuance directly in your portal. Our API enables a complete integration.

steps.title: Craft a template to issue passes via API
steps.description: Display your brand (or your customer's) in wallet with ease. Then issue credentials via API that are delivered via text.

steps.title: Users install your custom crafted credential
steps.description: With a SMS integration, your users receive a text message with a link to install the pass on their phone.
